01 Data Cleaning & Feature Transformation

Imported 2 Excel sheets (User Telemetry and HEART Analysis). Converted sentinels ("None", "N/A") to native NA, parsed timestamps to POSIXct, cleaned percentage strings, and factored categorical dimensions.

Cleaning Task Raw Input Format Standardized R Type Impact & Rationale
Missing Value Sentinels "None", "N/A", "null" NA_character_ Identified missingness across 50 columns without skewing numeric calculations.
Timestamp Parsing "01/08/2026, 02:17:48" POSIXct (dmy_hms) Derived hour (0-23), day_of_week, and is_weekend.
Scroll Depth % "78%" (Character) numeric (78.0) Enabled continuous correlation and regression modeling.
Session Duration "6m 21s" (Character) numeric (381 sec) Unified duration metrics into seconds and minutes.
Conversion Flag "YES" / "NO" factor & 1 / 0 Target response variable for Binomial Logistic Regression & CART.

03 Complete Visualisation Suite (11 Visualizations)

1. Line Chart: Hourly Traffic & Diurnal Cycle
Tracking hourly session volume across the 24-hour cycle.
2. Bar Chart: Conversion Rate by Device
Desktop (16.2%), Mobile (16.0%), and Tablet (12.8%) conversion rates.
3. Pie / Donut Chart: NPS Category Distribution
Detractors (35.7%), Passives (42.8%), Promoters (21.4%).
4. Histogram: Engagement Score Density Distribution
Overlaid KDE curves comparing purchasing vs non-purchasing visitors.
5. Boxplot: Session Duration by Device & Outcome
Purchasing visitors spend 13.2 minutes on average vs 2.8 minutes for bounces.
6. Heatmap: Day of Week vs. Hour of Day
2D session density revealing platform traffic hot zones.
7. Correlation Matrix: Behavioral & HEART Metrics
Correlogram matrix ordered by hierarchical clustering (corrplot).
8. Funnel Chart: Multi-Stage Conversion Funnel
Conversion progression from landing (5,000) to order confirmation (800).
9. Sankey / Alluvial Flow Diagram
Tracking flow: Device Hardware → Task Outcome → Purchase Status.
10. Treemap: Hierarchical Traffic Breakdown
Device Category > Browser > Purchase Conversion Status.
11. Time Series Plot: Daily Active Sessions
Daily trend of user session activity over the recorded time horizon.

Decision Tree Split Rules: - Node 1 (Root): engagement_score < 84.5 -> Not Purchased (4,200 users, 100% purity) - Node 2 (Root): engagement_score >= 84.5 -> Purchased (800 users, 100% purity) 3.
